summary: netapp.ontap in Ansible 15 adds AWS Lambda support to Active Directory, EMS, fpolicy, kerberos, nvme and other modules, and GCNV support to DNS, export policy, LDAP, license and EMS filter modules.

answer_card.title: netapp.ontap Lambda and GCNV support (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
- **AWS Lambda** support: `na_ontap_active_directory(_domain_controllers)`, `cg_snapshot`, `cli_timeout`, EMS modules, file security (`fdsd`, `fdsp`, `fdspt`, `fdss`, `file_security_permissions_acl`), fpolicy modules, kerberos modules, `login_messages`, `nvme`, `nvme_namespace`.
- **GCNV** support: `na_ontap_dns`, `na_ontap_ems_filter`, `na_ontap_export_policy(_rule)`, `na_ontap_ldap_client`, `na_ontap_license`.
